## How to interpret freshness and frequency

PostgreSQL does not keep a universal `last row updated` timestamp. This report therefore separates evidence:

- **Update cadence** is measured from `pg_stat_user_tables` insert/update/delete counters since the statistics reset. It describes observed average activity, not a contractual cron schedule.
- **Latest data evidence** uses the most relevant timestamp/date column and the latest value in PostgreSQL ANALYZE statistics. It is an estimate unless the application table itself guarantees that column as a watermark.
- **Views** are derived at query time. Partition parents and archive/legacy tables may show zero estimated rows while their children or allocated storage contain data.
- `—` means PostgreSQL exposes no reliable generic evidence. It is not treated as zero or current.

#### View definition

```sql
 SELECT s.signal_id,
    s.run_id,
    s.candidate_id,
    s.underlying,
    s.decision,
    s.confidence,
    s.rank,
    s.reason_codes,
    s.paper_submit_status,
    s.paper_trade_intent_id,
    s.paper_trade_group_id,
    s.created_at,
    c.structure_type,
    c.expiry,
    c.call_symbol,
    c.put_symbol,
    c.call_strike,
    c.put_strike,
    c.futures_price,
    c.combined_entry_ask,
    c.combined_spread_pct,
    c.implied_move_pct,
    c.forecast_implied_ratio,
    c.expected_return_pct,
    c.probability_profit,
    c.quote_source_as_of,
    c.quote_age_seconds,
    c.data_status,
    p.move_score_pre,
    p.move_score_live,
    p.predicted_abs_move_p50,
    p.predicted_abs_move_p75,
    p.predicted_abs_move_p90,
    p.direction_entropy AS movement_direction_entropy
   FROM fno_volatility.trade_signal s
     LEFT JOIN fno_volatility.option_candidate c ON c.candidate_id = s.candidate_id
     JOIN fno_volatility.movement_prediction p ON p.run_id = s.run_id AND p.underlying = s.underlying;
```

```sql
 SELECT market_date AS date,
    client_type,
    sum(
        CASE
            WHEN lower(instrument_type::text) ~~ '%future%index%'::text THEN COALESCE(open_interest_long, buy_contracts, 0::double precision)
            ELSE 0::double precision
        END) AS futures_index_long,
    sum(
        CASE
            WHEN lower(instrument_type::text) ~~ '%future%index%'::text THEN COALESCE(open_interest_short, sell_contracts, 0::double precision)
            ELSE 0::double precision
        END) AS futures_index_short,
    sum(
        CASE
            WHEN lower(instrument_type::text) ~~ '%future%stock%'::text THEN COALESCE(open_interest_long, buy_contracts, 0::double precision)
            ELSE 0::double precision
        END) AS futures_stock_long,
    sum(
        CASE
            WHEN lower(instrument_type::text) ~~ '%future%stock%'::text THEN COALESCE(open_interest_short, sell_contracts, 0::double precision)
            ELSE 0::double precision
        END) AS futures_stock_short,
    sum(call_long) AS options_index_call_long,
    sum(call_short) AS options_index_call_short,
    sum(put_long) AS options_index_put_long,
    sum(put_short) AS options_index_put_short,
    sum(COALESCE(open_interest_long, buy_contracts, 0::double precision) - COALESCE(open_interest_short, sell_contracts, 0::double precision)) AS net_bias
   FROM institutional_flow.normalized_nse_derivatives_participants
  GROUP BY market_date, client_type;
```

#### View definition

```sql
 WITH holdings AS (
         SELECT normalized_nse_shareholding.symbol,
            normalized_nse_shareholding.as_on_date,
            max(
                CASE
                    WHEN lower(normalized_nse_shareholding.category::text) ~~ '%foreign%'::text OR lower(normalized_nse_shareholding.category::text) ~~ '%fii%'::text THEN normalized_nse_shareholding.percent_hold
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END) AS fii_pct,
            max(
                CASE
                    WHEN lower(normalized_nse_shareholding.category::text) ~~ '%domestic%'::text OR lower(normalized_nse_shareholding.category::text) ~~ '%dii%'::text OR lower(normalized_nse_shareholding.category::text) ~~ '%mutual%'::text THEN normalized_nse_shareholding.percent_hold
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END) AS dii_pct,
            max(
                CASE
                    WHEN lower(normalized_nse_shareholding.category::text) ~~ '%promoter%'::text THEN normalized_nse_shareholding.percent_hold
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END) AS promoter_pct,
            max(
                CASE
                    WHEN lower(normalized_nse_shareholding.category::text) ~~ '%public%'::text THEN normalized_nse_shareholding.percent_hold
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END) AS public_pct
           FROM institutional_flow.normalized_nse_shareholding
          GROUP BY normalized_nse_shareholding.symbol, normalized_nse_shareholding.as_on_date
        )
 SELECT symbol,
    as_on_date,
    fii_pct,
    dii_pct,
    promoter_pct,
    public_pct,
    fii_pct - lag(fii_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY as_on_date) AS change_vs_prev_quarter_fii_pct,
    dii_pct - lag(dii_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY as_on_date) AS change_vs_prev_quarter_dii_pct,
    promoter_pct - lag(promoter_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY as_on_date) AS change_vs_prev_quarter_promoter_pct,
    public_pct - lag(public_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY as_on_date) AS change_vs_prev_quarter_public_pct
   FROM holdings;
```

#### Constraints

#### Indexes

No physical index (normal for views and some staging/partition parents).

#### View definition

```sql
 WITH deals AS (
         SELECT normalized_nse_bulk_block.market_date,
            normalized_nse_bulk_block.symbol,
            max(
                CASE
                    WHEN normalized_nse_bulk_block.deal_kind::text = 'bulk'::text THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END) AS bulk_deal_flag,
            max(
                CASE
                    WHEN normalized_nse_bulk_block.deal_kind::text = 'block'::text THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END) AS block_deal_flag
           FROM institutional_flow.normalized_nse_bulk_block
          GROUP BY normalized_nse_bulk_block.market_date, normalized_nse_bulk_block.symbol
        ), holding_latest AS (
         SELECT b_1.market_date,
            b_1.symbol,
            ( SELECT q.change_vs_prev_quarter_fii_pct
                   FROM institutional_flow.quarterly_holding_changes q
                  WHERE q.symbol::text = b_1.symbol::text AND q.as_on_date <= b_1.market_date
                  ORDER BY q.as_on_date DESC
                 LIMIT 1) AS quarterly_fii_holding_change_pct,
            ( SELECT q.change_vs_prev_quarter_dii_pct
                   FROM institutional_flow.quarterly_holding_changes q
                  WHERE q.symbol::text = b_1.symbol::text AND q.as_on_date <= b_1.market_date
                  ORDER BY q.as_on_date DESC
                 LIMIT 1) AS quarterly_dii_holding_change_pct
           FROM institutional_flow.normalized_nse_cm_bhavcopy b_1
        ), positioning AS (
         SELECT participant_positioning_summary.date,
            avg(participant_positioning_summary.net_bias) AS derivative_participant_bias
           FROM institutional_flow.participant_positioning_summary
          GROUP BY participant_positioning_summary.date
        )
 SELECT b.market_date AS date,
    b.symbol,
    b.close,
    b.volume,
    b.delivery_pct,
    COALESCE(d.bulk_deal_flag, 0) AS bulk_deal_flag,
    COALESCE(d.block_deal_flag, 0) AS block_deal_flag,
    h.quarterly_fii_holding_change_pct,
    h.quarterly_dii_holding_change_pct,
    p.derivative_participant_bias,
    COALESCE(d.bulk_deal_flag::double precision, 0::double precision) * 1.5::double precision + COALESCE(d.block_deal_flag::double precision, 0::double precision) * 2.0::double precision + COALESCE(h.quarterly_fii_holding_change_pct, 0::double precision) * 1.2::double precision + COALESCE(h.quarterly_dii_holding_change_pct, 0::double precision) * 0.8::double precision + COALESCE(b.delivery_pct, 0::double precision) * 0.05::double precision + COALESCE(p.derivative_participant_bias, 0::double precision) * 0.01::double precision AS institution_signal_score,
    TRIM(BOTH ';'::text FROM concat(
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(d.bulk_deal_flag, 0) = 1 THEN 'bulk_deal;'::text
            ELSE ''::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(d.block_deal_flag, 0) = 1 THEN 'block_deal;'::text
            ELSE ''::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(h.quarterly_fii_holding_change_pct, 0::double precision) <> 0::double precision THEN 'quarterly_fii_change;'::text
            ELSE ''::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(h.quarterly_dii_holding_change_pct, 0::double precision) <> 0::double precision THEN 'quarterly_dii_change;'::text
            ELSE ''::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(p.derivative_participant_bias, 0::double precision) <> 0::double precision THEN 'participant_positioning;'::text
            ELSE ''::text
        END)) AS explainability_notes
   FROM institutional_flow.normalized_nse_cm_bhavcopy b
     LEFT JOIN deals d ON d.market_date = b.market_date AND d.symbol::text = b.symbol::text
     LEFT JOIN holding_latest h ON h.market_date = b.market_date AND h.symbol::text = b.symbol::text
     LEFT JOIN positioning p ON p.date = b.market_date;
```

```sql
 WITH unified AS (
         SELECT fact_text_events.report_date AS trade_date,
            fact_text_events.symbol,
            fact_text_events.event_type AS tag
           FROM nse.fact_text_events
          WHERE fact_text_events.report_date IS NOT NULL AND fact_text_events.symbol IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL
         SELECT COALESCE(fact_corporate_actions.ex_date, fact_corporate_actions.report_date) AS trade_date,
            fact_corporate_actions.symbol,
            fact_corporate_actions.purpose AS tag
           FROM nse.fact_corporate_actions
          WHERE COALESCE(fact_corporate_actions.ex_date, fact_corporate_actions.report_date) IS NOT NULL AND fact_corporate_actions.symbol IS NOT NULL
        )
 SELECT trade_date,
    symbol,
    count(*)::integer AS event_count,
    string_agg(DISTINCT tag, ', '::text ORDER BY tag) AS event_tags
   FROM unified
  GROUP BY trade_date, symbol;
```

| 1 | `trade_date` | `date` | YES | `—` | — |
| 2 | `index_code` | `text` | YES | `—` | — |
| 3 | `close_px` | `numeric(18,6)` | YES | `—` | — |
| 4 | `close` | `numeric(18,6)` | YES | `—` | — |
| 5 | `high` | `numeric(18,6)` | YES | `—` | — |
| 6 | `low` | `numeric(18,6)` | YES | `—` | — |

#### Constraints

No declared table constraints.

#### Indexes

No physical index (normal for views and some staging/partition parents).

#### View definition

```sql
 WITH market_activity AS (
         SELECT fact_market_activity_index.trade_date,
                CASE
                    WHEN upper(fact_market_activity_index.index_name) = ANY (ARRAY['NIFTY 50'::text, 'NIFTY50'::text]) THEN 'NIFTY 50'::text
                    WHEN upper(fact_market_activity_index.index_name) = ANY (ARRAY['NIFTY BANK'::text, 'BANK NIFTY'::text]) THEN 'BANK NIFTY'::text
                    WHEN upper(fact_market_activity_index.index_name) = 'INDIA VIX'::text THEN 'INDIA VIX'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS index_code,
            fact_market_activity_index.close_price::numeric(18,6) AS close_px,
            fact_market_activity_index.close_price::numeric(18,6) AS close,
            fact_market_activity_index.high_price::numeric(18,6) AS high,
            fact_market_activity_index.low_price::numeric(18,6) AS low
           FROM nse.fact_market_activity_index
          WHERE upper(fact_market_activity_index.index_name) = ANY (ARRAY['NIFTY 50'::text, 'NIFTY50'::text, 'NIFTY BANK'::text, 'BANK NIFTY'::text, 'INDIA VIX'::text])
        ), minute_fallback AS (
         WITH index_map(index_code, symbol_token) AS (
                 VALUES ('NIFTY 50'::text,'99926000'::text), ('BANK NIFTY'::text,'99926009'::text), ('INDIA VIX'::text,'99926017'::text)
                )
         SELECT (b.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'::text)::date AS trade_date,
            im.index_code,
            (array_agg(b.close ORDER BY b.ts DESC))[1]::numeric(18,6) AS close_px,
            (array_agg(b.close ORDER BY b.ts DESC))[1]::numeric(18,6) AS close,
            max(b.high)::numeric(18,6) AS high,
            min(b.low)::numeric(18,6) AS low
           FROM bars_1m b
             JOIN index_map im ON im.symbol_token = b.symbol_token
          WHERE b.exchange = 'NSE'::text AND EXTRACT(isodow FROM (b.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'::text)) >= 1::numeric AND EXTRACT(isodow FROM (b.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'::text)) <= 5::numeric AND (b.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'::text)::time without time zone >= '09:15:00'::time without time zone AND (b.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'::text)::time without time zone <= '15:30:00'::time without time zone
          GROUP BY ((b.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'::text)::date), im.index_code
        )
 SELECT ma.trade_date,
    ma.index_code,
    ma.close_px,
    ma.close,
    ma.high,
    ma.low
   FROM market_activity ma
  WHERE ma.index_code IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
 SELECT mf.trade_date,
    mf.index_code,
    mf.close_px,
    mf.close,
    mf.high,
    mf.low
   FROM minute_fallback mf
  WHERE NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM market_activity ma
          WHERE ma.index_code = mf.index_code AND ma.trade_date = mf.trade_date));
```

#### Indexes

No physical index (normal for views and some staging/partition parents).

#### View definition

```sql
 WITH hist AS (
         SELECT market_minute_feature.trade_date,
            market_minute_feature.minute_ts,
            market_minute_feature.index_code,
            market_minute_feature.last_price,
            lag(market_minute_feature.last_price) OVER (PARTITION BY market_minute_feature.trade_date, market_minute_feature.index_code ORDER BY market_minute_feature.minute_ts) AS prev_last_price,
            abs(COALESCE(100.0 * (market_minute_feature.last_price / NULLIF(lag(market_minute_feature.last_price) OVER (PARTITION BY market_minute_feature.trade_date, market_minute_feature.index_code ORDER BY market_minute_feature.minute_ts), 0::numeric) - 1.0), 0.0)) AS abs_ret_1m_pct,
            market_minute_feature.gap_pct,
            market_minute_feature.open_range_15_pct,
            market_minute_feature.breadth_up_pct,
            market_minute_feature.breadth_above_vwap_pct,
            market_minute_feature.dispersion_pct,
            market_minute_feature.minute_no
           FROM nse_intraday.market_minute_feature
        ), with_pctiles AS (
         SELECT h.trade_date,
            h.minute_ts AS ts,
            h.minute_no AS minute_of_day,
            h.index_code,
            h.last_price AS index_close,
            COALESCE(100.0 * (h.last_price / NULLIF(h.prev_last_price, 0::numeric) - 1.0), 0.0) AS index_ret_1m_pct,
            h.breadth_up_pct,
            h.breadth_above_vwap_pct,
            COALESCE(100.0::double precision * cume_dist() OVER (PARTITION BY h.index_code, h.minute_no ORDER BY h.dispersion_pct), 0.0::double precision) AS dispersion_pctile,
            COALESCE(100.0::double precision * cume_dist() OVER (PARTITION BY h.index_code, h.minute_no ORDER BY h.abs_ret_1m_pct), 0.0::double precision) AS realized_vol_pctile,
            h.gap_pct AS opening_gap_pct,
            h.open_range_15_pct AS first15_range_expansion_pct,
            NULL::numeric AS correlation_mean
           FROM hist h
        )
 SELECT trade_date,
    ts,
    minute_of_day,
    index_code,
    index_close,
    index_ret_1m_pct,
    breadth_up_pct,
    breadth_above_vwap_pct,
    dispersion_pctile,
    realized_vol_pctile,
    opening_gap_pct,
    first15_range_expansion_pct,
    correlation_mean
   FROM with_pctiles;
```

#### View definition

```sql
 WITH session_dates AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT s.trade_date,
            s.index_code
           FROM integration.v_source_index_1m s
        ), index_map(index_code, symbol_token) AS (
         VALUES ('NIFTY 50'::text,'99926000'::text), ('BANK NIFTY'::text,'99926009'::text), ('INDIA VIX'::text,'99926017'::text)
        ), daily_index_close AS (
         SELECT (b.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'::text)::date AS trade_date,
            b.symbol_token,
            (array_agg(b.close ORDER BY b.ts DESC))[1]::numeric(18,6) AS close_px
           FROM bars_1m b
          WHERE b.exchange = 'NSE'::text AND (b.symbol_token = ANY (ARRAY['99926000'::text, '99926009'::text, '99926017'::text])) AND EXTRACT(isodow FROM (b.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'::text)) >= 1::numeric AND EXTRACT(isodow FROM (b.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'::text)) <= 5::numeric AND (b.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'::text)::time without time zone >= '09:15:00'::time without time zone AND (b.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'::text)::time without time zone <= '15:30:00'::time without time zone
          GROUP BY ((b.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'::text)::date), b.symbol_token
        )
 SELECT sd.trade_date,
    sd.index_code,
    prev.prev_close
   FROM session_dates sd
     JOIN index_map im ON im.index_code = sd.index_code
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT d.close_px AS prev_close
           FROM daily_index_close d
          WHERE d.symbol_token = im.symbol_token AND d.trade_date < sd.trade_date
          ORDER BY d.trade_date DESC
         LIMIT 1) prev ON true;
```

```sql
 WITH session_symbols AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT s.trade_date,
            s.symbol
           FROM integration.v_source_security_1m s
        ), token_map AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT c.symbol,
            c.symbol_token,
            c.sector AS sector_name,
            c.weight::numeric(18,8) AS universe_weight
           FROM index_constituents c
          WHERE c.index_name = 'NIFTY100'::text
        )
 SELECT ss.trade_date,
    ss.symbol,
    prev.prev_close,
    stats.avg_daily_volume_20d,
    tm.sector_name,
    tm.universe_weight,
    NULL::numeric(18,2) AS market_cap
   FROM session_symbols ss
     JOIN token_map tm ON tm.symbol = ss.symbol
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT d.close_price::numeric(18,6) AS prev_close
           FROM nse.fact_eod_prices d
          WHERE d.symbol = ss.symbol AND d.series = 'EQ'::text AND d.trade_date < ss.trade_date
          ORDER BY d.trade_date DESC
         LIMIT 1) prev ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT round(avg(d.volume), 0)::bigint AS avg_daily_volume_20d
           FROM ( SELECT d_1.total_traded_qty AS volume
                   FROM nse.fact_eod_prices d_1
                  WHERE d_1.symbol = ss.symbol AND d_1.series = 'EQ'::text AND d_1.trade_date < ss.trade_date
                  ORDER BY d_1.trade_date DESC
                 LIMIT 20) d) stats ON true;
```

```sql
    s.symbol,

    s.residual_return_30m_pct AS residual_ret_30m_pct,
    s.residual_return_60m_pct AS residual_ret_60m_pct,
    s.time_above_vwap_pct,
    (s.vwap_dev_bps / 100.0)::numeric(18,6) AS vwap_deviation_pct,
    COALESCE(s.volume_curve_surprise, 0.0) AS volume_surprise_z,
    (s.range_efficiency_pct / 100.0)::numeric(18,6) AS range_efficiency,
    (s.close_location_quality_pct / 100.0)::numeric(18,6) AS close_location,

     LEFT JOIN nse_intraday.market_minute_feature m ON m.trade_date = s.trade_date AND m.index_code = 'NIFTY 50'::text AND m.minute_ts = s.minute_ts;
```

```sql
            concat(m.symbol, ':', b.ts::text) AS source_pk,
            COALESCE(b.source, 'collector'::text) AS source_system
           FROM bars_1m b
             JOIN membership m ON m.symbol_token = b.symbol_token
          WHERE b.exchange = 'NSE'::text AND EXTRACT(isodow FROM (b.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'::text)) >= 1::numeric AND EXTRACT(isodow FROM (b.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'::text)) <= 5::numeric AND (b.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'::text)::time without time zone >= '09:15:00'::time without time zone AND (b.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'::text)::time without time zone <= '15:30:00'::time without time zone
        )
 SELECT minute_ts,
    trade_date,
    symbol,
    open_px,
    high_px,
    low_px,
    close_px,
    volume,
    turnover,
    vwap,
    trades,
    source_pk,
    source_system
   FROM filtered;
```

#### View definition

```sql
 WITH latest_names AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (fact_bhavcopy_udiff.symbol, fact_bhavcopy_udiff.series) fact_bhavcopy_udiff.symbol,
            fact_bhavcopy_udiff.series,
            fact_bhavcopy_udiff.security_name
           FROM nse.fact_bhavcopy_udiff
          WHERE fact_bhavcopy_udiff.security_name IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY fact_bhavcopy_udiff.symbol, fact_bhavcopy_udiff.series, fact_bhavcopy_udiff.trade_date DESC
        )
 SELECT p.trade_date,
    p.symbol,
    p.series,
    COALESCE(n.security_name, p.symbol) AS security_name,
    p.prev_close::numeric(18,6) AS prev_close,
    p.open_price::numeric(18,6) AS open,
    p.high_price::numeric(18,6) AS high,
    p.low_price::numeric(18,6) AS low,
    p.close_price::numeric(18,6) AS close,
    p.total_traded_qty AS volume,
    p.turnover_lacs::numeric(18,6) AS turnover_lacs,
    p.deliverable_qty,
    p.deliverable_pct::numeric(18,6) AS deliverable_pct
   FROM nse.fact_eod_prices p
     LEFT JOIN latest_names n ON n.symbol = p.symbol AND n.series = p.series;
```

```sql
 WITH base AS (
         SELECT 'NIFTY100'::text AS universe_name,
            c.symbol,
            c.weight::numeric(18,8) AS weight,
            c.sector AS sector_name,
            'collector_index_constituents'::text AS source_system
           FROM index_constituents c
          WHERE c.index_name = 'NIFTY100'::text
        ), trade_dates AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT v_source_security_1m.trade_date
           FROM integration.v_source_security_1m
        )
 SELECT b.universe_name,
    b.symbol,
    b.weight,
    b.sector_name,
    td.trade_date AS effective_from,
    NULL::date AS effective_to,
    b.source_system,
    td.trade_date,
    true AS is_active
   FROM trade_dates td
     CROSS JOIN base b;
```

No physical index (normal for views and some staging/partition parents).

#### View definition

```sql
 SELECT p.trade_date,
    COALESCE(p.fininstrm_id, u.fininstrm_id) AS fininstrm_id,
    COALESCE(p.isin, u.isin, sc.isin) AS isin,
    p.symbol,
    p.series,
    COALESCE(sc.security_name, u.security_name) AS security_name,
    p.prev_close,
    p.open_price,
    p.high_price,
    p.low_price,
    p.last_price,
    p.close_price,
    p.avg_price,
    p.total_traded_qty,
    p.turnover_lacs,
    p.no_of_trades,
    p.deliverable_qty,
    p.deliverable_pct,
    u.total_traded_value,
    u.total_trades,
    v.current_day_daily_volatility,
    v.annualised_volatility,
    hl.adjusted_52_week_high,
    hl.adjusted_52_week_low,
    si.non_default_flag_count AS surveillance_non_default_flag_count
   FROM nse.fact_eod_prices p
     LEFT JOIN nse.fact_bhavcopy_udiff u ON u.trade_date = p.trade_date AND u.symbol = p.symbol AND COALESCE(u.series, ''::text) = COALESCE(p.series, ''::text)
     LEFT JOIN nse.vw_security_current sc ON sc.symbol = p.symbol AND COALESCE(sc.series, ''::text) = COALESCE(p.series, ''::text)
     LEFT JOIN nse.fact_daily_volatility v ON v.trade_date = p.trade_date AND v.symbol = p.symbol
     LEFT JOIN nse.fact_52_week_high_low hl ON hl.report_date = p.trade_date AND hl.symbol = p.symbol AND COALESCE(hl.series, ''::text) = COALESCE(p.series, ''::text)
     LEFT JOIN nse.fact_surveillance_indicators si ON si.report_date = p.trade_date AND si.symbol = p.symbol AND COALESCE(si.series, ''::text) = COALESCE(p.series, ''::text) AND si.source_version = 'REG1'::text;
```

```sql
 SELECT snapshot_date,
    fininstrm_id,
    symbol,
    series,
    security_name,
    isin,
    lot_size,
    tick_size,
    price_range,
    listing_date,
    removal_date,
    instrument_type,
    instrm_name,
    market_segment,
    trad_to_trad_ind,
    settlement_type,
    trading_period,
    face_value,
    security_status,

    raw,
    loaded_at,
    rn
   FROM ( SELECT s.snapshot_date,
            s.fininstrm_id,
            s.symbol,

            s.security_name,
            s.isin,
            s.lot_size,
            s.tick_size,
            s.price_range,

            s.trading_period,
            s.face_value,
            s.security_status,
            s.normal_market_eligibility,
            s.raw,
            s.loaded_at,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s.fininstrm_id ORDER BY s.snapshot_date DESC) AS rn
           FROM nse.dim_security_master_snapshot s) x
  WHERE rn = 1;
```

#### View definition

```sql
 SELECT trade_date,
    fininstrm_id,
    isin,
    symbol,
    series,
    security_name,
    prev_close,
    open_price,
    high_price,
    low_price,
    last_price,
    close_price,
    avg_price,
    total_traded_qty,
    turnover_lacs,
    no_of_trades,
    deliverable_qty,
    deliverable_pct,
    total_traded_value,
    total_trades,
    current_day_daily_volatility,
    annualised_volatility,
    adjusted_52_week_high,
    adjusted_52_week_low,
    surveillance_non_default_flag_count,
        CASE
            WHEN prev_close IS NOT NULL AND prev_close <> 0::numeric THEN (close_price - prev_close) / prev_close
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS daily_return,
        CASE
            WHEN prev_close IS NOT NULL AND prev_close <> 0::numeric THEN (open_price - prev_close) / prev_close
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS gap_return,
        CASE
            WHEN open_price IS NOT NULL AND open_price <> 0::numeric THEN (close_price - open_price) / open_price
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS intraday_return,
        CASE
            WHEN low_price IS NOT NULL AND high_price IS NOT NULL AND low_price <> 0::numeric THEN (high_price - low_price) / low_price
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS day_range_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN high_price IS NOT NULL AND low_price IS NOT NULL AND high_price <> low_price THEN (close_price - low_price) / NULLIF(high_price - low_price, 0::numeric)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS close_location_value,
        CASE
            WHEN adjusted_52_week_high IS NOT NULL AND adjusted_52_week_high <> 0::numeric THEN (adjusted_52_week_high - close_price) / adjusted_52_week_high
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS distance_to_52w_high,
        CASE
            WHEN adjusted_52_week_low IS NOT NULL AND adjusted_52_week_low <> 0::numeric THEN (close_price - adjusted_52_week_low) / adjusted_52_week_low
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS distance_from_52w_low
   FROM nse.vw_eod_enriched e;
```

No physical index (normal for views and some staging/partition parents).

#### View definition

```sql
 WITH latest_date AS (
         SELECT max(security_daily_features.trade_date) AS d
           FROM nse_app.security_daily_features
        ), ranked AS (
         SELECT s.trade_date,
            s.symbol,
            s.series,
            max(s.signal_strength) AS max_signal_strength,
            string_agg(((s.signal_name || ' ['::text) || s.signal_direction) || ']'::text, ', '::text ORDER BY s.signal_strength DESC NULLS LAST, s.signal_name) AS signals
           FROM nse_app.stock_analysis_signals_daily s
             JOIN latest_date ld ON s.trade_date = ld.d
          GROUP BY s.trade_date, s.symbol, s.series
        )
 SELECT r.trade_date,
    r.symbol,
    r.series,
    f.security_name,
    f.close_price,
    f.daily_return,
    f.volume_rel_20,
    f.delivery_rel_20,
    f.composite_trend_score,
    f.composite_anomaly_score,
    f.composite_risk_score,
    r.max_signal_strength,
    r.signals
   FROM ranked r
     LEFT JOIN nse_app.security_daily_features f ON f.trade_date = r.trade_date AND f.symbol = r.symbol AND f.series = r.series
  ORDER BY r.max_signal_strength DESC NULLS LAST, f.turnover_lacs DESC NULLS LAST;
```

#### Columns

| # | Column | PostgreSQL type | Nullable | Default / generation | Description |
|---:|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `index_code` | `text` | YES | `—` | — |
| 2 | `primary_state` | `text` | YES | `—` | — |
| 3 | `session_count` | `bigint` | YES | `—` | — |
| 4 | `avg_session_change_pct` | `numeric` | YES | `—` | — |
| 5 | `avg_gap_pct` | `numeric` | YES | `—` | — |
| 6 | `avg_breadth_up_pct` | `numeric` | YES | `—` | — |
| 7 | `avg_breadth_above_vwap_pct` | `numeric` | YES | `—` | — |
| 8 | `avg_top10_concentration_pct` | `numeric` | YES | `—` | — |
| 9 | `avg_next_day_change_pct` | `numeric` | YES | `—` | — |
| 10 | `next_day_followthrough_pct` | `numeric` | YES | `—` | — |

#### Constraints

No declared table constraints.

#### Indexes

No physical index (normal for views and some staging/partition parents).

#### View definition

```sql
 WITH state_rows AS (
         SELECT s.trade_date,
            s.index_code,
            s.primary_state,
            s.change_pct,
            s.gap_pct,
            s.breadth_up_pct,
            s.breadth_above_vwap_pct,
            s.top10_concentration_pct,
            d.close_px AS day_close_px,
            lead(d.close_px) OVER (PARTITION BY d.index_code ORDER BY d.trade_date) AS next_close_px
           FROM nse_intraday.market_session_summary s
             LEFT JOIN integration.v_index_daily_history d ON d.trade_date = s.trade_date AND d.index_code = s.index_code
        )
 SELECT index_code,
    primary_state,
    count(*) AS session_count,
    round(avg(change_pct), 6) AS avg_session_change_pct,
    round(avg(gap_pct), 6) AS avg_gap_pct,
    round(avg(breadth_up_pct), 6) AS avg_breadth_up_pct,
    round(avg(breadth_above_vwap_pct), 6) AS avg_breadth_above_vwap_pct,
    round(avg(top10_concentration_pct), 6) AS avg_top10_concentration_pct,
    round(avg(
        CASE
            WHEN day_close_px IS NOT NULL AND next_close_px IS NOT NULL THEN 100.0 * (next_close_px / NULLIF(day_close_px, 0::numeric) - 1.0)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END), 6) AS avg_next_day_change_pct,
    round(100.0 * avg(
        CASE
            WHEN day_close_px IS NOT NULL AND next_close_px IS NOT NULL AND change_pct IS NOT NULL AND change_pct <> 0::numeric AND sign(100.0 * (next_close_px / NULLIF(day_close_px, 0::numeric) - 1.0)) = sign(change_pct) THEN 1.0
            WHEN day_close_px IS NOT NULL AND next_close_px IS NOT NULL AND change_pct IS NOT NULL AND change_pct <> 0::numeric THEN 0.0
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END), 6) AS next_day_followthrough_pct
   FROM state_rows
  GROUP BY index_code, primary_state;
```

| 2 | `sample_count` | `bigint` | YES | `—` | — |

#### Constraints

No declared table constraints.

#### Indexes

No physical index (normal for views and some staging/partition parents).

#### View definition

```sql
 WITH sec_close AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (raw_security_1m.trade_date, raw_security_1m.symbol) raw_security_1m.trade_date,
            raw_security_1m.symbol,
            raw_security_1m.close_px
           FROM nse_intraday.raw_security_1m
          ORDER BY raw_security_1m.trade_date, raw_security_1m.symbol, raw_security_1m.minute_ts DESC
        ), signal_rows AS (
         SELECT s.trade_date,
            s.symbol,
            s.dominant_signal,
            s.direction,
            s.change_pct_from_prev_close,
            sc.close_px AS day_close_px,
            lead(sc.close_px) OVER (PARTITION BY sc.symbol ORDER BY sc.trade_date) AS next_close_px
           FROM nse_intraday.stock_intraday_live s
             LEFT JOIN sec_close sc ON sc.trade_date = s.trade_date AND sc.symbol = s.symbol
        )
 SELECT dominant_signal,
    count(*) AS sample_count,
    round(avg(change_pct_from_prev_close), 6) AS avg_intraday_change_pct,
    round(avg(
        CASE
            WHEN day_close_px IS NOT NULL AND next_close_px IS NOT NULL THEN 100.0 * (next_close_px / NULLIF(day_close_px, 0::numeric) - 1.0)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END), 6) AS avg_next_day_change_pct,
    round(100.0 * avg(
        CASE
            WHEN day_close_px IS NOT NULL AND next_close_px IS NOT NULL AND (dominant_signal = ANY (ARRAY['residual-leader'::text, 'vwap-control-breakout'::text, 'catch-up-candidate'::text, 'intraday-strength'::text])) THEN
            CASE
                WHEN (100.0 * (next_close_px / NULLIF(day_close_px, 0::numeric) - 1.0)) > 0::numeric THEN 1.0
                ELSE 0.0
            END
            WHEN day_close_px IS NOT NULL AND next_close_px IS NOT NULL AND (dominant_signal = ANY (ARRAY['residual-laggard'::text, 'intraday-weakness'::text])) THEN
            CASE
                WHEN (100.0 * (next_close_px / NULLIF(day_close_px, 0::numeric) - 1.0)) < 0::numeric THEN 1.0
                ELSE 0.0
            END
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END), 6) AS next_day_followthrough_pct
   FROM signal_rows
  GROUP BY dominant_signal;
```

```sql
    s.vwap_dev_bps,
    s.sector_name,
    s.tags_json,
    s.notes,
    s.payload_json,
    s.generated_at
   FROM nse_ops.watchlist_snapshot_intraday s
     JOIN nse_ops.watchlist w ON w.watchlist_id = s.watchlist_id;
```

#### Constraints

No declared table constraints.

#### Indexes

No physical index (normal for views and some staging/partition parents).

#### View definition

```sql
 SELECT r.trade_date,
    r.index_code,
    r.horizon,
    r.symbol,
    r.asof_ts,
    r.signal_family,
    r.final_score,
    r.action,
    fr.close AS close_now,
        CASE
            WHEN fr.close_fwd_15m IS NOT NULL THEN 100.0 * (fr.close_fwd_15m / fr.close - 1.0)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS ret_fwd_15m_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN fr.close_fwd_30m IS NOT NULL THEN 100.0 * (fr.close_fwd_30m / fr.close - 1.0)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS ret_fwd_30m_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN fr.close_fwd_60m IS NOT NULL THEN 100.0 * (fr.close_fwd_60m / fr.close - 1.0)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS ret_fwd_60m_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN fr.close_eod IS NOT NULL THEN 100.0 * (fr.close_eod / fr.close - 1.0)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS ret_to_close_pct
   FROM nse_reco.recommendation_snapshot r
     JOIN nse_reco.v_security_forward_returns fr ON fr.trade_date = r.trade_date AND fr.symbol = r.symbol AND fr.ts = r.asof_ts;
```

#### View definition

```sql
 SELECT trade_date,
    index_code,
    horizon,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE action = 'buy_now'::text) AS buy_now_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE action = 'wait_for_pullback'::text) AS wait_pullback_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE action = 'watch_only'::text) AS watch_only_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE action = 'avoid_despite_strength'::text) AS avoid_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE action = 'anomaly_review_required'::text) AS anomaly_review_count,
    max(asof_ts) AS asof_ts,
    avg(final_score) AS avg_score
   FROM nse_reco.recommendation_snapshot
  GROUP BY trade_date, index_code, horizon;
```

```sql
 SELECT trade_date,
    symbol,
    ts,
    close,
    lead(close, 15) OVER (PARTITION BY trade_date, symbol ORDER BY ts) AS close_fwd_15m,
    lead(close, 30) OVER (PARTITION BY trade_date, symbol ORDER BY ts) AS close_fwd_30m,
    lead(close, 60) OVER (PARTITION BY trade_date, symbol ORDER BY ts) AS close_fwd_60m,

   FROM integration.v_security_minute_feature;
```

#### View definition

```sql
 SELECT w.watchlist_item_id,
    w.candidate_id,
    w.policy_id,
    w.trade_date,
    w.symbol,
    w.instrument_token,
    w.source,
    w.active,
    w.entry_enabled,
    w.daily_level,
    w.canonical_status,
    w.rank,
    w.buy_limit,
    w.no_chase_price,
    w.rsi_max,
    w.willr_max,
    w.notes,
    w.revision,
    w.created_by,
    w.updated_by,
    w.created_at,
    w.updated_at,
    c.signal_date,
    c.sector,
    c.data_quality,
    c.data_permission,
    c.ofactor,
    c.xfactor_snapshot,
    c.directional_edge,
    c.reference_price,
    c.component_scores,
    c.market_context,
    c.reason_codes,
    e.status AS entry_status,
    e.signal_ts,
    e.paper_trade_group_id,
    c.ofactor_level,
    c.directional_edge_level,
    c.extension_level,
    c.volume_level,
    c.feature_values,
    c.gate_evidence,
    c.universe_flags,
    c.direction,
    c.structural_direction,
    c.session_direction,
    c.direction_state,
    c.session_direction_score,
    c.opportunity_rank,
    c.execution_rank,
    c.data_coverage,
    c.setup_id,
    c.setup_state,
    c.quality_score,
    c.auto_paper_eligible,
    c.auto_paper_selected
   FROM oiis_live.watchlist_item w
     LEFT JOIN oiis_live.daily_candidate c ON c.candidate_id = w.candidate_id
     LEFT JOIN oiis_live.entry_claim e ON e.policy_id = w.policy_id AND e.trade_date = w.trade_date AND e.symbol = w.symbol;
```

#### Indexes

#### View definition

```sql
 SELECT c.candidate_id,
    c.run_id,
    c.policy_id,
    c.policy_version,
    c.signal_date,
    c.trade_date,
    c.symbol,
    c.instrument_token,
    c.sector,
    c.direction,
    c.daily_level,
    c.canonical_status,
    c.selected,
    c.rank,
    c.data_quality,
    c.data_permission,
    c.ofactor,
    c.xfactor_snapshot,
    c.directional_edge,
    c.rsi14,
    c.willr14,
    c.ema61,
    c.macd_line,
    c.atr14,
    c.volume_vs_sma20,
    c.reference_price,
    c.buy_limit,
    c.no_chase_price,
    c.component_scores,
    c.market_context,
    c.condition_results,
    c.reason_codes,
    c.evidence,
    c.observed_at,
    c.available_at,
    c.created_at,
    c.ofactor_level,
    c.directional_edge_level,
    c.extension_level,
    c.volume_level,
    c.volume_percentile_90,
    c.failed_gate_count,
    c.blocking_gate_count,
    c.recommended,
    c.recommendation_rank,
    c.feature_values,
    c.gate_evidence,
    c.universe_flags,
    c.structural_direction,
    c.session_direction,
    c.direction_state,
    c.session_direction_score,
    c.opportunity_rank,
    c.execution_rank,
    c.data_coverage,
    c.setup_id,
    c.setup_state
   FROM oiis_live.daily_candidate c
     JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT r.run_id
           FROM oiis_live.selection_run r
          WHERE r.trade_date = c.trade_date AND r.status = 'COMPLETED'::text
          ORDER BY r.completed_at DESC NULLS LAST, r.started_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) latest ON latest.run_id = c.run_id;
```

#### View definition

```sql
 SELECT o.run_id,
    o.signal_date,
    o.symbol,
    o.sector,
    o.entry_date,
    o.entry_ts,
    o.path_status,
    o.selected_direction,
    o.decision_code,
    o.ofactor_long,
    o.ofactor_short,
    o.directional_edge,
    o.xfactor_score,
    o.close_price,
    o.entry_price,
    o.rsi_14,
    o.willr_14,
    o.ema_61,
    o.close_vs_ema61_pct,
    o.bb_lower_20_2,
    o.bb_mid_20,
    o.bb_upper_20_2,
    o.bb_position,
    o.fast_k_14,
    o.slow_k_3,
    o.volume,
    o.volume_sma_20,
    o.volume_ema_20,
    o.volume_ema_60,
    o.macd_line_12_26,
    o.macd_signal_9,
    o.macd_histogram,
    o.nifty_close,
    o.nifty_primary_trend,
    o.stock_primary_trend,
    o.vix_regime,
    o.intraday_mfe_pct,
    o.intraday_mae_pct,
    o.d5_mfe_pct,
    o.d5_mae_pct,
    o.h30_max_high_upside_pct,
    o.h30_max_close_upside_pct,
    o.h30_mae_pct,
    o.nifty_d5_return_pct,
    o.nifty_h30_return_pct,
    o.stock_excess_nifty_d5_pct,
    o.stock_excess_nifty_h30_pct,
    o.ofactor_long_components,
    o.ofactor_short_components,
    o.xfactor_components,
    o.gate_results,
    o.indicator_payload,
    o.outcome_payload,
    o.observation_hash
   FROM oiis_research.all_signal_observation o
     JOIN ( SELECT all_signal_run.run_id
           FROM oiis_research.all_signal_run
          WHERE all_signal_run.status = 'COMPLETED'::text
          ORDER BY all_signal_run.completed_at DESC NULLS LAST
         LIMIT 1) r USING (run_id);
```

#### Constraints

No physical index (normal for views and some staging/partition parents).

#### View definition

```sql
 SELECT p.exchange,
    p.symbol_token,
    p.strategy,
    p.side,
    p.qty,
    p.avg_price,
    p.entry_price,
    p.entry_ts,
    p.stop_loss,
    p.take_profit,
    p.realized_pnl,
    COALESCE(s.last_price, p.avg_price) AS mark_price,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(upper(p.side), 'BUY'::text) = 'SELL'::text THEN (p.avg_price - COALESCE(s.last_price, p.avg_price)) * p.qty::numeric
            ELSE (COALESCE(s.last_price, p.avg_price) - p.avg_price) * p.qty::numeric
        END AS unrealized_calc,
    p.realized_pnl +
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(upper(p.side), 'BUY'::text) = 'SELL'::text THEN (p.avg_price - COALESCE(s.last_price, p.avg_price)) * p.qty::numeric
            ELSE (COALESCE(s.last_price, p.avg_price) - p.avg_price) * p.qty::numeric
        END AS total_pnl,
    p.updated_at
   FROM paper_positions p
     LEFT JOIN instrument_state s ON s.exchange = p.exchange AND s.symbol_token = p.symbol_token;
```

#### View definition

```sql
 SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.strategy_id, r.scenario_key) s.strategy_id,
    s.display_name,
    v.strategy_version_id,
    r.backtest_run_id,
    r.scenario_key,
    r.scenario_label,
    r.as_of_date,
    e.policy_version,
    e.result_type,
    e.rankability_status,
    e.rating,
    e.quality_score,
    e.revenue_capacity_score,
    e.validation_status,
    e.validation_json,
    e.good_when_json,
    e.avoid_when_json,
    e.watch_json,
    e.limitation_json,
    e.evaluated_at,
    e.evaluation_id
   FROM nse_app.backtest_strategy s
     JOIN nse_app.backtest_strategy_version v ON v.strategy_id = s.strategy_id
     JOIN nse_app.backtest_run r ON r.strategy_version_id = v.strategy_version_id
     JOIN strategy_eval.run_evaluation e ON e.backtest_run_id = r.backtest_run_id
  ORDER BY s.strategy_id, r.scenario_key, r.as_of_date DESC, e.evaluated_at DESC;
```

# Operational conclusions

1. Treat streaming tick/quote/depth/OI partitions as the freshest live estate; verify their timestamps and collector health together.
2. Treat daily/batch feature and report tables as current only for their intended session/report date—not merely because PostgreSQL is connected.
3. Treat `migration_backup_20260808`, `legacy`, and historical partitions as retained archives, not current serving tables.
4. A zero PostgreSQL row estimate is not proof that a partition parent or unanalyzed relation is empty. Use child partitions and exact application queries for release decisions.
5. Regenerate this document after migrations or scheduler changes; cadence classifications are observations from the stated statistics window.
